audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty text described Karma as a burst threat and used male pronouns throughout ('his burst window', 'his engage range'). Karma is a poke/utility mid whose threat is a 950-range Inner Flame plus a 675-range tether root.
audit.why: Inner Flame (Q) is 950 range on 9/8/7/6/5s; Focused Resolve (W) is 675 range on a flat 12s. Breath of Light is 750 range, so she out-ranges the poke but must step inside your beam range to root.
audit.corrected: Difficulty stays 7/10: she owns levels 1-5 by out-ranging you and by rooting you out of the Q channel; you take over on the first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed between layers: phases[4..6].side read 'Skill' while win[4]='Karma' and win[5..6]='Aurelion Sol'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Karma x5 then Aurelion Sol x2, matching the content layer. The full layer was stale.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side='Karma', phases[5].side='Aurelion Sol', phases[6].side='Aurelion Sol' — proposed as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere stated that Focused Resolve (W) cancels Breath of Light's channel and stops Astral Flight, which is the interaction the whole lane runs on.
audit.why: Owner kit flags both Q and W as 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it'; Karma's W is hardCC (root). Missing-interactions list flags exactly this ('your-channel-punished') plus her Mantra-W self-heal needing Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad, dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d: start Q at 750, back out of 675, and never spend Astral Flight while Focused Resolve is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d called Focused Resolve a 'fifteen-second' cooldown.
audit.why: Kit file: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] called Inner Flame a root and whys[0]/[1]/[6] described an 'orbiting stars' kit Aurelion Sol no longer has.
audit.why: Inner Flame is a slowing projectile; the root is Focused Resolve. Current Aurelion Sol has Breath of Light, Astral Flight, Singularity and Falling Star.
audit.corrected: Both fixed with the real ability names.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve (Tether): matchup-defining — The root tether — break it with range or line of sight. Check it before every step-up. - W Astral Flight is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve (W): 12s flat at every rank, 675 range — it cancels your Q channel and your Astral Flight, so step up only once it is spent. - Inner Flame is her real poke at 950 range, down to 5s late. - Mantra is a 40s cooldown, not a moment.

edits.after: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Breath of Light across Karma for two seconds of burn and Stardust, and land back outside her 675-range tether.

edits.before: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, burn Karma on every W rotation, and group early — your beam turns small mid-game leads into unanswerable objective control.
edits.after: Ahead, deny her the wave: E-execute the back line, and every time Focused Resolve goes on its 12s cooldown, fly in and burn her off the lane before she can shield through it.

edits.before: If Karma gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Focused Resolve (Tether) extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with E executes and stay relevant through the stardust curve.
edits.after: If Karma gets a kill, her Mantra is up more often — stay outside 675 and never channel Q at her without Astral Flight. Two kills: farm the back line with black holes and let the Stardust curve carry you.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
